entries.title: Zechariah 2:1
segments: ¶Then I raised my eyes and looked, and behold, a man with a measuring line in his hand.

entries.title: Zechariah 2:2
segments: So I said, "Where are you going?" And he said to me, "To measure Jerusalem, to see what [is] its width and what [is] its length."

entries.title: Zechariah 2:3
segments: And there [was] the angel who talked with me, going out; and another angel was coming out to meet him,

entries.title: Zechariah 2:4
segments: who said to him, "Run, speak to this young man, saying: 'Jerusalem shall be inhabited [as] towns without walls, because of the multitude of men and livestock in it.

entries.title: Zechariah 2:5
segments: 'For I,' says the LORD, 'will be a wall of fire all around her, and I will be the glory in her midst.'"

entries.title: Zechariah 2:6
segments: ¶"Up, up! Flee from the land of the north," says the LORD; "for I have spread you abroad like the four winds of heaven," says the LORD.

entries.title: Zechariah 2:7
segments: "Up, Zion! Escape, you who dwell with the daughter of Babylon."

entries.title: Zechariah 2:8
segments: For thus says the LORD of hosts: "He sent Me after glory, to the nations which plunder you; for he who touches you touches the apple of His eye.

entries.title: Zechariah 2:9
segments: "For surely I will shake My hand against them, and they shall become spoil for their servants. Then you will know that the LORD of hosts has sent Me.

entries.title: Zechariah 2:10
segments: ¶"Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion! For behold, I am coming and I will dwell in your midst," says the LORD.

entries.title: Zechariah 2:11
segments: "Many nations shall be joined to the LORD in that day, and they shall become My people. And I will dwell in your midst. Then you will know that the LORD of hosts has sent Me to you.

entries.title: Zechariah 2:12
segments: "And the LORD will take possession of Judah as His inheritance in the Holy Land, and will again choose Jerusalem.

entries.title: Zechariah 2:13
segments: "Be silent, all flesh, before the LORD, for He is aroused from His holy habitation!"
